title: Fidelity-Based Quantum Robustness Margins
description:
Toolbox for analysing (and optionally synthesising) piecewise-constant coherent quantum gate controllers under scalar structured Hamiltonian perturbations, accompanying the paper Fidelity-Based Robustness Margins for Finite-Time Quantum Control.

It implements the gate-fidelity sensitivity bound, the Lipschitz constant it induces, and an iterative one-dimensional robustness margin that certifies finite perturbations preserving a prescribed fidelity threshold. MATLAB, Octave and Python implementations are peers, cross-checked by golden fixtures and consistency tests, and reproduce the paper's three-qubit case study end to end. A supplementary layer implements the Kosut-Lidar-Rabitz fundamental bound (arXiv:2507.01215) specialised to this closed-system coherent perturbation model, so the margin it implies can be compared with the certified Lipschitz margin.
